lifetime: Synchronous, stateless calls borrow caller UTF-8 bytes. A non-null sink is called exactly once after successful projection, including empty output, and borrows the complete UTF-8 result until the sink returns. The sink must not unwind across C. It returns zero on acceptance; any other value produces SINK. No output pointers or handles survive return. The caller must join all accepted calls before unloading code.
budget: A size_t projection budget bounds individual text assemblies and aggregate generated heading/table text. Zero admits empty projection only; SIZE_MAX imposes no explicit text limit. Refusal invokes no sink. This is not an aggregate memory budget or an allocation-failure guarantee.
profile: Profile sink receives JSON: python_version, tokenizer_sha256, owner_sha256 and native_sources SHA-256 witnesses. The declared Python tokenizer profile is the semantic version; host Python/Rust versions do not redefine it.
authority: Pure HTML text projection only. No storage, account, fallback, worker, environment selection or default activation authority.
